formal_statement: (∀ (n : ℕ) (S T St : Submodule ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)), S ≠ ⊥ → T ≠ ⊥ → (∀ x, x ∈ St ↔ ∀ v ∈ S * T, x * v ∈ S * T) → Module.finrank ℂ S + Module.finrank ℂ T ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (S * T) + Module.finrank ℂ St) → (∀ (M : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℂ (Fin M → ℂ)), (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 0) → (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i, x i ^ 3 = 0) → 3 * Module.finrank ℂ W ≤ M)
plain_statement: If Kneser's theorem for codes holds over C (statement of L-gct-065), then every linear space in C^M killing both power sums p2 and p3 has dim <= M/3 (statement of L-gct-061). Polarization, Kneser with S = W + C1 and T = W, and induction over the 0/1 blocks of the stabilizer.
title: Kneser for codes over C implies the sharp Fermat lemma (L-gct-065 implies L-gct-061)
